title: Welcome Trojans Orientation (USC New Student Orientation)
text:
Note: this page's only explicit year is 2026 (spring admits must commit to USC by July 1, 2026). It gives session months, not exact dates.

FORMATS AND DATES
- Fall admits: virtual or on-campus. A full-day, on-campus option at the University Park Campus runs in June or July. Plan to stay the whole day and avoid leaving before 5 p.m.
- Spring admits: online in winter through the Trojan Engagement Center. A summer on-campus event is held in mid-July for students who commit to USC by July 1.

SIGN-UP PROCESS
- Starting in April, certified students receive an email invitation.
- Steps: reserve a Welcome Trojans Orientation (online or in person), add up to two guests (undergraduates only), and review pre-orientation requirements.
- Event-specific details are sent by email.

COURSE REGISTRATION AND ADVISING
- Academic advising and course registration for your first semester are completed online.

WHAT IS INCLUDED
- Academic advising and course registration
- Live informational webinars and Q&A sessions
- On-demand modules
- Opportunities to connect with USC students and staff
- Access to the Trojan Engagement Center (weekly emails, webinars, recordings, student services and campus resource information, on-demand guides). It is available to students and registered guests through the first month of each semester.

CONTACTS
- Office of Orientation Programs, Student Union Building, Suite B-7, 3601 Trousdale Parkway, Los Angeles, CA 90089-0892
- Phone: (213) 740-7767
- Email: orientation@usc.edu
- Hours: Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific time
